simple.summary: חֲצַר שׁוּעָל (Chătsar Shûwʻâl) means Chatsar-Shual , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 28.

definitions.full: H2705. Chatsar Shual שׁוּעָל חֲצַר proper name, of a location 1 place in southern Judah Josh 15:28 = 1Chr 4:28 ; Neh 11:27 2 place in Simeon Josh 19:3 . — ᵐ5 Αρσωλα , Χολασεωλα , Ασαρσουλα , Ασαρσουαρ , etc.
